sentences.text:
Amit Rajaram Phase vs The State Of Maharashtra on 22
December, 2023

913 aba 3609 of 2023.d
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Anticipatory Bail Application No.3609 Of 2023
Amit Rajaram Phase ... Applicant
 versus
The State of Maharashtra ... Respondent
Mr. Piyush Toshnival with Mr. Aniket Nikam i/by Mr. Amit Icham, for Applicant.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: .  Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R.No.156 of 2023 registered with Kundal Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328, read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

3. The applicant apprehends arrest in connection with the aforesaid crime as the co-accused in whose possession the contraband articles - Gutakha Pan masala, has been seized, has named the applicant as the alleged supplier of the contraband articles.

4. In identical matters, this Court has granted interim relief and posted the matters for consideration on 30 January 2024 as the question of applicability of Section 328 of the Penal Code in a case of the present nature awaits decision of the 913 aba 3609 of 2023.doc Supreme Court.

5. In view of the above, in the event of arrest of the applicant in CR No.156 of 2023, registered with Kundal Police Station, the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a PR Bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.
